name: Courage Over Fear
description: A series through Joshua: God’s promise of the land, faith in Canaan, Jericho, Achan’s sin, second chances at Ai, and the Gibeonite deception.
note: Josh launches the series in Joshua 1 and ends it with Frenemy.
